sources.locator: Faure et al. (2024), Eqs. (9), (12), (23)-(25); Table 1; Methods: Lasso regression models.
whmatrixextms-benchmarking.ipynb: H_matrix_recursive, H_matrix, V_matrix; whmatrixextms.py fit_lasso (fit_intercept=False).

scope: All nine printed Table 1 background-averaged coefficients, not unrounded experimental coefficients.
preprocessing: Uniform observed Cartesian product; fitness as supplied, maximize=True, epsilon=0; no imputation, transformations, duplicates, sample weighting or measurement-error propagation; graph nodes verified unchanged. Reference is first observation. No RNG in OLS. Two sites are embedded at original positions 6 and 66; full 3x3 population, max_order=2.

comparison.justification: Half the last printed decimal unit; inputs and expected coefficients are both printed to two decimals. No claim of agreement to unreported precision.
